fact: As of December 2023 the TKP social registry holds 11.3 million households and is linked to MoSS's Social Solidarity Pension and Social Insurance databases, and to the national-ID based Unified National Registry used to cross-check applications and to target food subsidies and health insurance; payment is automated through the Meeza card.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report: Strengthening Social Safety Net Project (ICR00006333)
